answer: Admission is a single scarce berth at a public jetty. A newcomer posts a slashable bond and must complete one unique delivery whose route and receipt hash are derived from the epoch seed, so two keys cannot reuse the same work. Reviewers stand on a stepped terrace of already-established operators and may endorse at most two newcomers each epoch; overlapping key timing or route hashes slash every shared bond. The harbor posts a fresh juniper tag, a checksum of the prior checkpoint, to name those reviewers so farms cannot shop for friendly signers.
